defects.summary: pageOf slices to start + size - 1, so a page holds 19 rows and the twentieth row of every page is never shown.
undo does not await store.save: the command prints its result before the state is stored, and a write that fails is an unhandled rejection instead of exit 1.
wholeNumber refuses only a value that is both not an integer and below min (&& where || is meant), so 0, -3, 2.5 and text that is no number are accepted as a page number or a threshold.
export joins the name from the command line into a path without valid.fileName, so ../ in it writes the report outside exports/.

count runs one load-change-save per pair at once with Promise.all: each loads the same state and the saves overwrite one another (or collide on the temporary file), so counts are lost; a later pair that is refused does not stop the earlier ones.
exportRows catches a failed mkdir or write, passes it to warn and still gives rows.length, so the command says the rows were written and exits 0.
count adds an item for a SKU that is not in the inventory; the feature document's Done when says such a count is refused with exit 1 and nothing stored.
